pagerbot: AUTOMATED PAGE -> PagerDuty PD-1788 fired for service= inference-gateway-usw2; symptom=5xx_rate spike (+125% last 5m); threshold=100/min; incident_id=PD1788 :rotating_light:
pagerbot: links: https://pd.example/PD-1788 | runbook: docs/runbooks/inference-5xx
alice.sre: acked PD-1788 I'm oncall for the next 30m, taking lead. starting triage now.
bob.platform: noted. any recent deploys to inference-gateway-usw2?
deploy-bot: deploy complete: id=deploy-2026-03-18-17:02 by ci-bot -> services: inference-gateway (v2.14.7) - started 10m ago
alice.sre: copying runbook snippets — step1: check edge/kvcache evictions; step2: check origin 502s; step3: consider fallback to model-variant-lowmem.
alice.sre: running `kubectl logs -n prod inference-gateway-7f9b -c gateway --since=5m | grep "5.." | head`
alice.sre: paste: "upstream response: 502 bad gateway: upstream=kv-proxy time=12ms ctx=xyz" repeating 140x in last 4m
carol-support: customer-impact: support queue shows 12 tickets referencing 502 responses for completions, highest from AcmeCorp (paying). escalations open.
dan.product: flagging SLA risk to account team. any ETA?
alice.sre: checking kv-proxy memory and eviction metrics — looks like kvcache eviction rate jumped 4x right after deploy-2026-03-18-17:02. suspect regression in kv client.
bob.platform: can we roll the kv-proxy or scale it up? we have spare capacity in dedicated pool.
alice.sre: attempting controlled scale: `kubectl scale deployment/kv-proxy --replicas=6 -n prod` -> scaling...
alice.sre: scale change applied, pods coming up.
deploy-bot: initiated canary-rollback for deploy-2026-03-18-17:02 -> target service=kv-client-lib (v2.3.1 -> v2.3.0) per alice.sre request
alice.sre: rollback in progress, monitoring 5xx rate
eve-sre: I'll take over if this crosses into multi-region — on stand-by.
carol-support: posting to customers: we sent a short note to AcmeCorp stating we are investigating increased 5xx errors and will provide updates every 15m.
bob.platform: after scale and rollback we should see TTL of kv cache rebuild, expect ~60-90s for hitrate to stabilize.
alice.sre: 5m check: 5xx rate dropped ~60% vs spike peak but still ~40% above baseline. continuing.
dan.product: prepare backup plan for traffic reroute to secondary region if it rebounds.
alice.sre: agreed. runbook step: enable fallback routing: `route set inference-gateway->fallback=true region=usw2` (will start draining to fallback variant)
alice.sre: enabled fallback routing, confirming traces show traffic splitting 20% to fallback.
carol-support: customers notified update: "errors reduced, mitigation in progress" :thumbsup:
alice.sre: PD-ack passback: marking PD-1788 as "acknowledged" and setting next update in 10m. handing to eve-sre for extended monitoring. :white_check_mark:
eve-sre: got it. I'll watch for regressions and follow up with postmortem owner assignment if we need one.
alice.sre: final note before handoff: likely root cause = kv-client regression in deploy-2026-03-18-17:02 causing high eviction and origin 502s. action items: rollback confirmed, scale applied, fallback enabled, customer comms sent.
carol-support: thanks — I'll keep AcmeCorp and the support queue updated.
alice.sre: closing temporary lead. leaving open until 5xx back to baseline.
pagerbot: PD-1788 status update: acknowledged by alice.sre; responders=6; severity=high; customer-impact=partial; next_update=1788888930
summary: Automated PagerDuty page for 5xx spike in inference-gateway, ack, scale and rollback mitigation, customer comms, and on-call handoff
